item.title: 25 Years of Saving Lives: Go inside Henrico Humane Society's Pet Expo
item.description: Henrico Humane Society's 25th Pet Expo at Richmond Raceway Complex features 70+ vendors, contests, and adoptable pets to support life-saving animal rescue work.

item.title: Johnston's 21 help Richmond take down Saint Bonaventure 99-94
item.description: Led by Will Johnston's 21 points, the Richmond Spiders defeated the Saint Bonaventure Bonnies 99-94. The Spiders are now 15-13 on the season, while the Bonnies moved to 14-13.

item.title: Avdalas and Lawal each score 17 points as Virginia Tech beats Wake Forest 82-63
item.description: Neoklis Avdalas and Tobi Lawal each scored 17 points and Virginia Tech pulled away in the second half for an 82-63 win over Wake Forest on Saturday.
